intro: Once the Stones of Binding were opened, much of the voice's confinement eased, yet a lock still holds it. That lock is the Keystone among a ring of stones, and the stone watcher Fozruk, one of the voice's captors, holds the key, known to the watchers as the Rod of Order.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Opening the Stones of Binding loosened much of my confinement, but a lock still holds me chained. It is the Keystone you see among this circle of stones. And the key is held by one of my captors, the stone watcher Fozruk.
You must obtain that key, which the stone watchers call the Rod of Order, from Fozruk and use it to open the Keystone.
Friend, you have done so much to aid me. Just a little more...and my gratitude will shake the very foundations of the earth!

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Keystone is charged with tremendous geomantic energy.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the rod in the keystone. And a shudder is felt beneath you...
